sections.name: Unit I - Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Agents

questions.q: Artificial Intelligence is best described as the field that enables machines to:
options: Perform tasks that normally require human intelligence

questions.q: Which statement best captures the meaning of intelligence in AI?
options: The ability to print documents quickly
The ability to reason, learn, and adapt effectively to achieve goals
The ability to use a keyboard without errors
The ability to increase network speed

questions.q: The primary goal of AI is to develop systems that can:
options: Reduce the need for software testing
Solve complex problems and behave intelligently in varying environments

questions.q: Strong AI is best described as a system that:
options: Performs a narrow set of tasks efficiently
Matches human-level general intelligence across many domains

questions.q: Weak or narrow AI is characterized by:
options: Specialized performance in a limited domain

questions.q: General AI is different from narrow AI because it aims to:
options: Be optimal for just one application
Handle a wide range of tasks at human-like capability

questions.q: The term superintelligence is best understood as:
options: A machine that can only solve math proofs
A device with more memory than a server
A system that outperforms humans in most cognitive tasks

questions.q: AI differs from conventional programming mainly because AI systems often:
options: Learn from data and adapt to new situations

options: Coined the field of artificial intelligence as a research discipline

questions.q: The expert systems era was mainly characterized by:
options: Large rule-based systems encoding human expertise

questions.q: AI winters are typically associated with:
options: Periods of reduced funding and optimism due to unmet expectations

questions.q: Modern AI is best described as relying heavily on:
options: Large-scale data, learning algorithms, and computational power

questions.q: Which of the following is a major application of AI?

options: The system is connected to a keyboard

options: Modeling how humans think and reason

options: Behaving in a way that is indistinguishable from a human in performance

options: A program that perceives an environment and acts through sensors and actuators
